notes: droopescan is quiet but shallow on Joomla; joomscan is louder and enumerates components/CVEs. Run both - they miss different things.

recommended.note: Manual fingerprinting that scopes this scan.
Attack the admin login once enumerated.

name: Joomla - droopescan / joomscan Enumeration
description: Automated Joomla/Drupal enumerators. droopescan and joomscan fingerprint version, components, and modules to guide exploitation.

defense.why_it_works: droopescan probes known Joomla paths for installed extensions, plugins, and themes, then cross-references versions with vulnerability databases. It also checks administrative URLs and identifies outdated core versions from manifest files.
defense.prerequisites: HTTP access. No authentication required. Joomla running with default file layout.
defense.impact: Full extension inventory with CVE mapping — attacker knows which plugins have known RCE, LFI, or privilege escalation vulnerabilities before any login attempt.
defense.detection: Rapid sequential GET requests to Joomla manifest paths from one IP. User-Agent matching known scanners.
defense.artifacts: Access logs showing manifest/extension path enumeration | WAF alerts for scanner activity
defense.prevention: Deny direct access to /administrator/manifests/ via web server config. Keep all Joomla extensions updated. Restrict /administrator/ to known IPs.
defense.misconfiguration: Extension manifests at /administrator/manifests/packages/ accessible from unauthenticated requests.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Apache -- default config allows directory listing of /administrator/manifests/
<Directory /var/www/html>
    Options Indexes FollowSymLinks   # Indexes = directory listing enabled
    AllowOverride None
    Require all granted
</Directory>

# Joomla -- manifest files publicly readable, expose version info
# /administrator/manifests/files/joomla.xml reveals exact CMS version
defense.secure_config:
# Apache -- disable directory listing, restrict /administrator/
<Directory /var/www/html>
    Options -Indexes -FollowSymLinks
    AllowOverride None
    Require all granted
</Directory>

<Directory /var/www/html/administrator>
    Require ip 10.0.0.0/8    # internal access only
</Directory>

# .htaccess in /administrator/manifests/
Deny from all

# Joomla Global Config: SEO URLs on, remove version meta tag
# System > Global Configuration > Site > Show Joomla Version: No
defense.evasion: Obfuscate the injected template webshell and remove it after; blend admin actions into normal usage; avoid leaving the malicious extension/template enabled.
